seed: Treat counter, HUD, legend and indicator objects as state that other rules read, such as remaining moves, the selected item or goal progress, and model their updates exactly.

synth.notes:
Lights-out board: click toggles tile color_14<->color_15 (bbox hit-test).
Operator click toggles its marker_14/15 and the orthogonal tiles at +-8 (glyph neighbours untouched).
Glyphs inert; empty clicks and non-click actions are no-ops.
No counter/HUD objects in schema, so counter hypothesis not applicable; fully stateless.
Unconfirmed: operator effects beyond 4 orthogonal tiles (diagonals/longer range never observed).
